_about: Rules for videos uploaded for analysis (notes/upload_plan.md section 2). Written before any upload was processed.
A video is analysed only if it passes stage A (the file) and stage B (camera and picture); it is published only if it also passes stage C (the result).

normalise._note: Every upload is converted to at most 10 frames per second (never more than the source) and at most 1920 px wide before analysis: enough for speeds, about 3x faster on GitHub's CPU. The whole frame is analysed.

picture._cut_note: Steady test clips stay at or below 10, a real cut measured 55; set before any user upload.

analysis.tracker_note: ByteTrack, low-confidence floor 0.15, 4 s memory: chosen on the 4 fps phone clip (notes/tracking.md section 7); its memory is in seconds, so it carries over to 10 fps.
